title: The green edge of India
alt: Rolling green hills and cloud-covered valleys in Northeast India
description: Slow mornings, cool air, and views that feel almost cinematic. This trip leans into the beauty and calm of the hills.

itinerary.title: Settle into Shillong
itinerary.text: Arrive and ease into the city with a short evening walk and scenic food stops.

itinerary.title: Clouds and viewpoints
itinerary.text: Spend the day exploring viewpoints, gardens, and quiet roads with flexible time for photos.

itinerary.title: A village in the green
itinerary.text: Head to Mawlynnong and enjoy the slower rhythm of a village surrounded by nature.

itinerary.title: Rainy-season mood
itinerary.text: Visit Cherrapunji or nearby sights depending on weather, road conditions, and your pace.

itinerary.title: Take the scenic route
itinerary.text: Keep a day light for additional local stops, coffee breaks, and unplanned moments.

itinerary.title: One last morning
itinerary.text: Enjoy a calm breakfast before your onward transfer.
